description: Portable (no-installer) zip layout for OpenBurnBar. Unzip anywhere and run OpenBurnBar.App.exe; the .portable marker makes the app keep its data next to the executable instead of %LOCALAPPDATA%.
note: version is a placeholder seed (macOS MARKETING_VERSION is 1.0.28); New-PortableZip.ps1 -Version overrides it and the release pipeline supplies the shipping version.

source.description: Produced by `dotnet publish windows/app/OpenBurnBar.App -c Release -r <rid> --self-contained true`. WindowsAppSDKSelfContained=true means the WinAppSDK runtime + WebView2 loader + Win2D native bits are already in the publish folder — no machine-wide dependency.

generatedFiles.contents: OpenBurnBar portable mode. Presence of this file makes the app store its database, logs, and settings under a `Data\` folder next to the executable instead of %LOCALAPPDATA%\OpenBurnBar. Delete it to fall back to per-user storage.

OpenBurnBar (portable)
======================

1. Unzip this folder anywhere you can write (a USB drive, a project folder, %LOCALAPPDATA%).
2. Run OpenBurnBar.App.exe.
3. The tray icon appears; click it for the flyout, or open the main window.

This build is UNSIGNED unless it came from an official release. Verify the .sha256
sidecar against the value published on the GitHub release before running.

Updates: the app auto-updates from the Ed25519-pinned release feed (parity with the
macOS Sparkle feed); the feed key is pinned independent of any code-signing certificate.

Uninstall: quit the app (tray > Quit) and delete this folder. In portable mode all data
lives in the Data\ subfolder, so nothing is left behind on the machine.
